$comment: Platform preference for the review operation's seats (see scripts/lib/review-seat-settings.mjs). parallelSeats on|off: every juror seat of a review-pr run starts at once instead of one after another (tool override env WE_REVIEW_PARALLEL_SEATS). seatsByTouchSet on|off: the review daemon picks the seat list from the PR's touch-set before the run starts, so an all-prose PR (e.g. backlog cards only) does not seat the security juror; code PRs keep both mandatory seats (tool override env WE_REVIEW_SEATS_BY_TOUCH_SET). speculativeRedTeam on|off (scripts/lib/review-speculative-red-team.mjs): the review job starts the post-accept red team beside the juror seats and keeps it only on accept; deliberately NOT set here, so the platform preference (review.speculativeRedTeam in scripts/lib/delivery-platform-preferences.json) or the standard default (on) applies; set it here only to override for this repo (env WE_REVIEW_SPECULATIVE_RED_TEAM beats both). shadowSeats.antigravity.model names the agy model for the SHADOW mandatory seats only (advisory, never counted; trial of Gemini 4 Argon from 2026-10-13); absent = the routing policy's model; on an Argon failure the seat re-runs loudly on the routing policy's model; env WE_REVIEW_SHADOW_AGY_MODEL beats it. shadowSeats.antigravity.trialReviews is the trial length in completed shadow reviews (one review-pr run where that model returned a usable answer), not days (operator 2026-10-13); the report node scripts/lib/agy-shadow-trial-report.mjs shows N of that count and says trial complete when reached; reaching it never promotes anything (env WE_REVIEW_SHADOW_AGY_TRIAL_REVIEWS beats it).
